title: Research Moonshine on-device voice stack for the web workspace
description: Inventory Moonshine STT/VAD/intent/TTS components, browser support, licensing, and maturity. Map them onto the one-turn, scale-to-zero architecture and propose a design with costs. Deliverable: docs/VOICE.md research note.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Research written to docs/VOICE.md (uncommitted in branch claude/moonshine-voice-support-221dff). Key findings: Moonshine Voice 0.1.5 ships @moonshine-ai/moonshine-wasm (MIT) with streaming STT + embedded Silero VAD + TTS + AgentFlow; English Tiny Streaming is ~45 MB. Needs COOP/COEP (SharedArrayBuffer). No wake word, no hosted API, Safari/iOS untested. Recommended design: always-on local STT, teammate name as wake word, deterministic local command grammar, only addressed lines become ordinary POST /messages turns, speechSynthesis for short spoken summaries. Four feasibility tests gate the build.
